label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.75… supports Whoever is attributed an intellectual…
note: ST I q.75 a.2 co. states that the intellectual principle 'habet operationem per se', treating understanding as an operation of what understands. The premise states that whoever is attributed an intellectual exercise operates; the passage concerns the human intellectual principle, and the generalization to every bearer of an intellectual exercise is the analyst's.
